Break the import from:

`src/domain/billing.ts` → `src/presentation/invoice-view.ts`

This is the best edge to remove because it both participates in the three-file cycle and violates the configured architecture: the domain layer must not depend on presentation.

Move any shared type or pure helper into a leaf module owned by the domain layer, then let both files import it. If `billing.ts` only needs a TypeScript type, change the edge to `import type`; otherwise, inject a domain-owned interface or move the presentation-specific behavior back into `invoice-view.ts`.

This preserves the intended dependency direction—presentation/application may depend on domain, never the reverse—and resolves both the high-severity cycle and the medium-severity layer violation with one change.
